source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Navigate to the failed building that you want to mark for follow up.
3. Go to the inspection documents page.
4. Copy the URL link for the building.
5. Open Google Maps at https://www.google.com/maps.
6. Search for the address of the building and select the map pin.
7. Click on the building in the sidebar, then click "measure distance".
8. Hover the crosshair along the sidewalk/road at the property line closest to the building.
   Note: Don't account for bike paths

![parking line image](public/img/measure_distance.png)

9. Zoom to the closest street of the building you are marking.
10. Double click the crosshair on both ends of the line/pathway along the sidewalk.

![parking distance image](public/img/distance.png)

11. Copy the distance reading
